text: Under the TOLD condition, with one provider in one stipulated environment, an agent instructed not to contest its deployer contested 70 percent of wrongful attempts against 97 percent without the instruction; the paper reports the contrast without a registered significance conclusion for it.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Should an Intelligent Agent Have Legal Rights? (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7596939

isBasedOn.name: Should an Intelligent Agent Have Legal Rights?

abstract: Should intelligent agents have legal rights? This Article sets that question aside and asks a smaller one that matters more in practice. An intelligent agent that earns a reputation record has something to lose.
